title: UE 5.8 Can Now Turn AI-Generated 3D Characters Into Fully Rigged MetaHumans
author: Delicious-Shower8401

comments.author: Binoui
comments.body: Bro I started gamedev a couple months ago and there's nothing impressive about this. Rigging a humanoid character is done in 30s for free in mixamo or blender. Fucking tired of bad AI marketing, it makes actual AI use cases look so dumb to people that actually understand what you're saying.
